magnitude.carry.help: Carry: look at a target and use /magnitude carry request; accept, decline, drop, escape, recover. Players must consent; carrier must be at least twice as large.
magnitude.carry.held: Target held in front of you.
magnitude.carry.requested: Carry request sent. The target can accept or decline.
magnitude.carry.recovery: You are detached. A safe landing is pending; use /magnitude carry recover to retry.
magnitude.carry.no_request: There is no current carry request.
magnitude.carry.no_relation: You are not carrying or being carried.
magnitude.carry.denied: This action is not permitted or the client is missing Magnitude.
magnitude.carry.invalid_target: Look at a nearby player or pig.
magnitude.carry.out_of_range: The target is too far away or in another dimension.
magnitude.carry.size_mismatch: The carrier must be at least twice the target size (supported scales: 0.25–4).
magnitude.carry.busy: A participant is already carrying, carried, recovering, or unavailable.
magnitude.carry.blocked: The path or landing space is blocked.
magnitude.carry.budget: Too much interaction work is pending. Try again shortly.
magnitude.carry.io_failure: Recovery data could not be saved. Contact the server operator; safely placed targets will not be controlled again.
magnitude.carry.not_ready: The carry service is unavailable. Contact the server operator.
magnitude.carry.invitation: %s wants to carry you. Use /magnitude carry accept or /magnitude carry decline within 10 seconds.
